items.title: George Justin Interview, 1958-06-01
items.q: He was another fellow that Heinz had commented on

ctx.x: Did you run across the fellow named Handy? Oh yes, he still plays, yeah. Oh is he?
Yeah. He was another fellow that Heinz had commented on because there was a time.
He's about the best alto sax around there now. No I don't know. He plays clarinet too.
